items.title: ‘Open War’ Between Afghanistan and Pakistan Adds a Volatile Element
items.summary: The two sides turn to proxy groups after eight months of a conflict that has taken a heavy toll on civilians.

items.title: Archers Mount Their Steeds in Pursuit of Centuries-Old Warrior Spirit
items.summary: Horseback archery is making a comeback at a time when modern warfare has become high-tech and impersonal. The sport was featured at the World Nomad Games.

items.title: Palestinians Hope Israeli Election Will Oust Netanyahu

items.title: UK to Headphone Dodgers on Trains: Shush

items.title: Drone Strike Kills More Than 150 in Abyei in Sudan’s Civil War
items.summary: Struggling against each other on the battlefield, the sides in Sudan’s civil war are relying on drones to strike across vast distances, inflicting huge tolls on civilians in the process.

items.title: Macron Says Trump Does Not Like France and Distorts Its Troubles

items.title: Delhi’s Winter Season of Polluted Air Begins

items.title: Australian Politicians Were Already on Edge Before One of Their Own Was Attacked
items.summary: Much remains unclear about why a driver ran a car into Helen Haines, a lawmaker. Even so, fellow representatives, especially women, spoke of feeling threatened in a polarized atmosphere.

items.title: Looted Goods From French Stores Appear on Resale Sites After Riots
